subject: german
title: Stamp 1: The Founding of the DDR
welcome_lead: Stamp the birth of East Germany and the building of the Wall.
meta_desc: A-Level German adventure on the founding of the DDR and Berlin Wall.

concepts.def: Deutsche Demokratische Republik; East German state founded 7 October 1949.
Bundesrepublik Deutschland; West German state founded 23 May 1949.
Berlin Wall built from 13 August 1961 to stop emigration to the West.
Ministerium fur Staatssicherheit; East German secret police controlling daily life.
Sozialistische Einheitspartei Deutschlands; ruling party of the DDR.
Iron Curtain; symbolic and physical division between East and West.

walkthroughs.body_html: After WWII Germany was divided into four occupation zones. The Western zones merged into the BRD on 23 May 1949; the Soviet zone became the DDR on 7 October 1949.
By 1961, around 2.7 million East Germans had fled to the West. On 13 August 1961, the SED ordered the Berlin border sealed overnight. Walls and watchtowers soon stretched 155 km around West Berlin.
The Stasi employed around 91,000 officers and 189,000 informers (inoffizielle Mitarbeiter). Files filled 111 km of shelves. Files are now open to victims through the BStU agency.

mcqs.q: In 'Heute gehe ich ins Kino', why does 'gehe' come second?
options: Heute is always followed by a verb.
Word order is free.
German is a V2 language - the conjugated verb is the second element in main clauses.
Nominative.

options: Nominative.
Accusative - 'Ich helfe DICH'.
